acceptanceCriteria: A shell unit whose only matching token is a lone file name is selected only when that name resolves under its working directory
Regression test with a README.md-only shell reader
body: After PR #1138 (V1-1806, AFP-V0-072) Go lone-file-name readers must place the dirty path, but shell units are not narrowed: script/check-host-package-versions_test.sh is selected for docs/specs/README.md by the token README.md alone. Expected: a shell unit names a path only when its token can be placed relative to its known working directory. Evidence: lane gh-affbroad1806 analysis on the PR #1134 range.
title: affected: shell test readers are selected by a lone file name (README.md) with no placement narrowing
